description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git checkout paths behavior, including setup, checkout operations, and validation checks.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, setting up a block of commands.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the internal clock for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a given path is missing.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command should fail.

methods.name: test_tool
methods.description: Runs a tool with specific options, e.g., to change file modification times.
